blocks.text: Southwest homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Southwest, September 2026. Detached houses: 41 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 22% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 8 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 38%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 30 sold over 4 months against an average of 52.8 listed, about 7.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 9 sold. Condos and townhomes: 7 sold over 4 months against an average of 10.5 listed, about 6.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 3 sold.

faq.q: Which schools are in Southwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Hammond Elementary (K–7, 11520 203 Street), Maple Ridge Elementary (K–7, 20820 River Road) and Westview Secondary (8–12, 20905 Wicklund Avenue) are physically in the area; catchments are address-specific — check SD42's School Locator.

faq.q: How do I get to downtown Vancouver or Langley?
faq.a: Maple Meadows Station on the West Coast Express runs weekday trains to Waterfront Station, and the Golden Ears Bridge at the area's west side connects to Langley and Surrey.

faq.q: Can a house here have a suite, and what about septic?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot is permitted inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain); in the Fraser River Escarpment policy area, new residences require sanitary sewers and septic fields are to be avoided.

faq.q: What do buyers need to know about the escarpment?
faq.a: Lots between 207 Street, 124 Avenue, 224 Street and the escarpment crest are under City Policies 6.23 and 6.24: drainage must go to the City storm system, and lots within 300 m of the crest need a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant before building.

faq.q: What major projects are proposed for the area?
faq.a: The City put two Hammond projects to an assent vote: the Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre at 20601 Westfield Avenue / 11509 207 Street and the Hammond Multi-Use Community Park at 20818 Golf Lane on the golf course site, under Loan Authorization Bylaws No. 8123-2026 and No. 8124-2026; the Hammond Area Plan update was adopted by Council, enabling mixed-use, higher-density buildings.
